description: This file defines request handlers for configuration management in a gateway server, including getting, setting, patching, applying configs, and opening config files. It references various internal modules for config parsing, validation, and restart handling.

methods.name: requireConfigBaseHash
methods.description: Checks if the provided config base hash matches the current snapshot hash, responds with error if not.

methods.name: parseRawConfigOrRespond
methods.description: Extracts raw config string from parameters, responds with error if invalid.

methods.name: sanitizeLookupPathForLog
methods.description: Sanitizes a config path for logging by replacing control characters and truncating long paths.

methods.name: escapePowerShellSingleQuotedString
methods.description: Escapes single quotes in a string for PowerShell command usage.

methods.name: resolveConfigOpenCommand
methods.description: Generates platform-specific command to open a config file.

methods.name: execConfigOpenCommand
methods.description: Executes the command to open a config file.

methods.name: formatConfigOpenError
methods.description: Formats error message from attempting to open config file.

methods.name: parseValidateConfigFromRawOrRespond
methods.description: Parses raw config string, validates, and restores redacted values; responds with errors if invalid.

methods.name: didSharedGatewayAuthChange
methods.description: Determines if shared gateway authentication settings have changed between configs.

methods.name: queueSharedGatewayAuthDisconnect
methods.description: Queues disconnection of clients using shared gateway auth if needed.

methods.name: summarizeConfigValidationIssues
methods.description: Summarizes validation issues into a concise string.

methods.name: ensureResolvableSecretRefsOrRespond
methods.description: Ensures secret references in config can be resolved, responds with error if not.

methods.name: resolveConfigRestartRequest
methods.description: Extracts restart request parameters and routing info.

methods.name: buildConfigRestartSentinelPayload
methods.description: Builds payload for restart sentinel with config change info.

methods.name: tryWriteRestartSentinelPayload
methods.description: Attempts to write restart sentinel payload, returns null on failure.

methods.name: loadSchemaWithPlugins
methods.description: Loads the runtime config schema with plugins.
